title: Which Concern Is This?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Classify six teacher statements as awareness, informational, or personal concerns, and read the response that answers each one.

learningObjectives: The learner will classify six teacher statements as awareness, informational, or personal concerns, and match each to the response that answers it, correctly classifying at least five of six on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Stages of concern, self concerns, and stages 0 to 2, from the section "CBAM: Concerns at the Start" in Chapter 17.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: "What exactly does it do?" Which stage?
"Will I be evaluated on how quickly I adopt this?" Which stage?
commonMisconceptions: A teacher with a self concern is resisting
A personal concern is about students
assessmentOpportunities: "What exactly does it do?" Which stage?
"Will I be evaluated on how quickly I adopt this?" Which stage?
Is a personal concern about students?

controls.name: 3 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the stages; two tries per statement.

controls.name: Show meanings
controls.description: Opens a table of the stages and their meanings.

controls.name: Previous missed, Next missed
controls.description: On the results screen, page through the missed items.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: Reshuffles the items for a practice run.
